summary: EZGO Technologies filed a Form 6-K disclosing a 1-for-3 reverse share split of its ordinary shares, approved by the board on August 6, 2026, with post-split trading on Nasdaq beginning November 5, 2026 under symbol EZGO and new CUSIP G5279F128. Outstanding shares fall from 5,305,950 to approximately 1,768,650, with fractional shares rounded up to one full share. The move is intended to lift the per-share price and maintain Nasdaq continued listing compliance; no shareholder vote was required under British Virgin Islands law, and VStock Transfer acts as exchange agent. Watch for post-split price stabilization and any further listing-deficiency notices.
